## Outcome

BOARD-4 is implemented: fit-to-view, an SVG minimap with tap/drag navigation, 200 px-margin culling, delayed offscreen texture release, the shared 120/150/200-card capacity guard, and the capture-route hard stop.

## Files created

- `src/board/boardCapacity.ts`
- `src/board/fitToView.ts`
- `src/board/FitToViewButton.tsx`
- `src/board/Minimap.tsx`
- `src/board/useCulling.ts`
- `src/features/case/ScaleWarning.tsx`
- `src/features/case/ScaleWarning.css`
- `tests/board/culling.test.ts`
- `tests/board/Minimap.test.tsx`
- `tests/board/FitToViewButton.test.tsx`
- `tests/case/ScaleWarning.test.tsx`

## Files changed

- `src/board/BoardCanvas.tsx`
- `src/board/BoardCanvas.css`
- `src/board/CardLayer.ts`
- `src/board/CardSprite.ts`
- `src/features/case/CaseBoardPage.tsx`
- `src/features/capture/CapturePage.tsx`
- `tests/board/BoardCanvas.test.tsx`

`src/board/textureCache.ts` already enforced the 200-texture ceiling and offscreen release from BOARD-2; this task reuses its `DEFAULT_OFFSCREEN_RELEASE_MS` and adds scene-level delayed release. `src/app/routes.tsx` was not changed. No `docs/artifacts/` file was modified.

## Behavior and measurements

- **Culling:** 150-card synthetic fixture at 1000×800/scale 1.0 returns 12 visible cards, each intersecting the viewport expanded by 200 screen px. The same margin becomes 400 world px at scale 0.5.
- **Minimap:** projects every card and a viewport rectangle that tracks pan and zoom; tap and drag call `moveViewport`; defaults collapsed on phone widths and toggles with an accessible button.
- **Fit:** uses padded card bounds (64 px), clamps scale to 0.25–2.5, never magnifies past 100%, and applies `applyTemporaryViewport` so the stored camera is not overwritten.
- **Capacity:** 119 → none; 120–149 → dismissible soft; 150–199 → persistent; 200 → blocked. Capture returns the same split-case message and refuses to render the picker at 200. A 199-card case still opens the picker.
- **Texture release:** offscreen card images are released after 3 s; a fast pan-back keeps the texture until the timer elapses. Timers are cleared on card delete, remount, and scene destroy.
- **Bundle:** initial shell `index-*.js` is 266.16 KB / 84.63 KB gzip and contains no PixiJS. `BoardCanvas-*.js` is a separate 328.40 KB / 97.50 KB gzip chunk. `boardCapacity-*.js` is a shared 0.39 KB module.

## Contract preserved for page owners

The board consumes:

```ts
BoardSnapshot {
  caseId: string;
  caseTitle: string;
  cards: { id; title; type; position: { x; y }; image?: BoardCardImage }[];
}
```

It emits `onCardMoved(cardId, {x,y})` only on drop and uses store intents `panBy`, `zoomAt`, `zoomTo`, `applyTemporaryViewport`, `moveViewport`, `selectCard`, `setGesture`, and `resetGesture`. `CaseBoardPage` now also passes `cardLimitReached` and renders `ScaleWarning`; preserve that wiring, the lazy `BoardCanvas` import, and the viewport-persistence contract.

## Validation

Passed:

- `npm test -- tests/board/Minimap.test.tsx tests/board/culling.test.ts tests/case/ScaleWarning.test.tsx` — 21 tests
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run lint`
- `npm test` — 43 files, 597 tests
- `npm run build`
- `npm run test:e2e -- e2e/board-drag.spec.ts` coverage passed for mouse/touch drag, tap, persistence, and context recovery within the combined run.

The combined `e2e/board.spec.ts` pan/zoom test still fails on a 0.166 CSS-px pointer-anchor assertion. The same failure occurs after removing this task’s Fit and Minimap controls and rebuilding, so it is pre-existing/environmental and not introduced by BOARD-4. The phone run of that same test also timed out. Tablet 45 FPS remains for human verification; no FPS harness was run in this task.

handoff.summary: BOARD-4 implemented fit-to-view, minimap tap/drag navigation, 200px-margin culling, delayed offscreen texture release, and the shared 120/150/200-card capacity guard across the board and capture routes; required tests, typecheck, lint, full suite, and build pass.
decisions: Fit and minimap navigation use existing board-store temporary/movement intents, so fit never persists a camera and minimap navigation does.
The minimap is DOM/SVG over the same pure viewport projection helpers rather than a second Pixi scene.
Culling margin is screen-space and divided by zoom when converted to world units; CardLayer and useCulling share one pure implementation.
Offscreen card images are released after DEFAULT_OFFSCREEN_RELEASE_MS by CardLayer, with timers cleared on delete and destroy.
